brief.headline: Push for a price cut to the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band on caps — market shows headroom — and accelerate payment to 15 days to free up ₹2.39 L cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range on induction-wad caps at higher volume.
priceAsk.basis: The open market shows typical asks of ₹0.85–0.95/pc are MARKET-FAIR, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. We buy ₹58.17 L a year — enough volume to hit that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Speeds up payment by 15 days, freeing ₹2.39 L cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj Blow Plast publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹58.17 L annual spend is material enough to matter, but without their numbers we can't gauge how hard to press. The play is to line up a strong second source and use that optionality to justify the price and payment asks — treat them as a capable but unaudited supplier we need a backup for.

evidence.point: We spend ₹58.17 L a year with them — a volume big enough to command better pricing.
Market asking prices for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps run ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
The market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec.
Pulling payment in by 15 days frees up ₹2.39 L working cash for us.
We currently pay 30 days after receipt — not our worst terms, but tightening helps our cash.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score 73/100) doing pails, containers and pharma packaging — robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India resin maker; medium confidence as a potential upstream source.

risks: No public financials means we're flying blind on their cash health and staying power — if they hit trouble, we have no early warning.
Pressing too hard on price and payment together could spook a smaller private supplier who may already be cash-tight (we just don't know).
The market headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc assumes higher volume or looser spec — confirm our actual order size and tolerance before locking that target.
The alternates (Manjushree, Mold-Tek) are much larger and may have higher MOQs or longer lead times — qualifying them will take time, so start now.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹58.17 L a year with you on caps, and the market shows room to move pricing down to ₹0.65–0.80 at our volume — let's talk about hitting that band and tightening payment to 15 days so we both move faster.
